preparation: Human SMCT1 in Xenopus oocytes. Coupling n=2 is the published value cited by the Cells law. These are same-study consistency checks.
temperature_note: The steady-state methods report approximately 24 °C. A separate zero-current clamp temperature was unspecified. The ratio of shifts is independent of temperature.

charge_per_lactate.locator: Fig. 1B, current at −50 mV and radiolactate uptake, mean of five weekly regression slopes.

osmolytes_per_charge.locator: Fig. 2, independent lactate current and volume method.

ratio_of_zero_current_shifts.locator: Fig. 4A–B and accompanying results. Pair each sodium halving with a substrate halving at the starting sodium concentration. The authors report a mean ratio for each substrate across experiments. The isolated carrier comparison assumes fixed internal activities and the same conductance weighting for the paired shifts.

exclusion: The inhibitor-sensitive voltage-clamp reversal includes a separate anion leak. Propionic acid also crosses the oocyte membrane independently. Neither the mixed reversal nor raw propionate tracer uptake is an isolated coupled current.
